entries.result: n=60 fold4 images: recipe A path reproduces stored TTA to 0.15%; full-data members agree within 0.5-0.8% log spread; memory-efficient SDPA asserted; peak 2.64 GiB under a 15 GiB cap; 12.9 s/image on H200 (Phase-1 40 views x 6 members ~11 s of it). entries.question: can detector quality be lifted beyond the 20 annotated images (GT-scored selection, soft-hex6 weak loss, external Topcon pre-training)?
entries.result: G1a GT-correlation selection: r 0.38-0.56 uncorrelated with held-out F1 (400-row SE ~0.045; 2000-row re-test queued); as 14th member B -0.0282. Subset selection B -0.0272. G1b soft-hex6 surrogate failed its 20-image test (r -0.15/0.28) -> parked. External pre-training round 1 (2000 updates, 1.30x): val-5 F1 .642 unchanged, coverage unchanged (ROI-sized cluster), B -0.0286; round 2 (transfer check, 6000 updates, 1.11x) queued. G3 delivered: 9 fold-99 detectors, full-fit a=-0.223 b=0.584 w=0.26, Hex6Corrector 0.68 s/image, tests pass, LOFO estimate -0.0274 on B.
entries.verdict: hex6 on the hybrid is pinned at -0.027..-0.029 regardless of detector work; submission-2 fallback package exists
